stem: Which location is near a transform plate boundary?
visual_elements:
A table that describes four separate geologic locations is shown.

Location            Description
Location A        •  No volcanic rocks present
                          •  Area experiences moderate to large-scale earthquakes
Location B        •  Volcanic rocks present
                          •  Light to moderate volcanic activity daily
Location C        •  No volcanic rocks present
                          •  No evidence of seismic activity in the last 10,000 years
Location D        •  Volcanic rocks present
                          •  Moderate earthquake activity yearly
